title: AAWSAP to AATIP to Elizondo to New York Times chain

tellings.quote: There's a chain you can draw a direct link OSAP to ATIP to to Lu Alzano to New York Times.

plain: A direct line runs from AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded UFO study that began around 2007, to AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. From there it runs to Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official tied to that office, and on to the New York Times, which first reported on the programme in 2017. That is how the commentator Marik von Rennenkampff puts it on the show, in an episode about challenging the UFO skeptic Mick West to a debate. He gives the chain to argue that the 2017 news did not come from nowhere: it traces back to real government programmes.
